name: adb-claw
description: Android device control CLI for AI agent automation. Realtime path: observe once, act from state_id/center, never re-dump on tap --index.

tools.name: observe
tools.description: Capture screenshot + UI tree. Writes state_id snapshot. JSON never includes image bytes. Tap using UI tree device pixels.
tools.returns: state_id, screenshot.path + sizes/scale, UI elements with index/handle/id/text/bounds/center, optional profile
tools.when_to_use: Before deciding an action. After an action only when the page may have changed. Read the screenshot file; do not paste JSON into notes.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the device screen.
tools.usage: adb-claw screenshot [-f file.jpg] [--capture auto|stream|pull] [--format jpeg|png] [--quality 70] [--width px] [--profile]
tools.returns: screenshot.path plus device/image size, scale, capture mode
tools.when_to_use: When you only need the visual state without UI element data.

tools.name: tap
tools.description: Tap a coordinate or a cached UI element. --index/--id/--text use the last observe snapshot and do not dump unless --refresh.
tools.usage: adb-claw tap {X Y | --index N | --id RESOURCE_ID | --text TEXT} [--refresh]
tools.when_to_use: Prefer coordinates or last-observe index. --refresh only when the snapshot is missing or stale.

tools.name: long_press
tools.description: Long press a coordinate or cached UI element.
tools.usage: adb-claw long-press {X Y | --index N | --id ID | --text TEXT} [--duration 1000] [--refresh]
tools.when_to_use: For context menus or long-press actions.

tools.name: swipe
tools.description: Swipe from one point to another.
tools.usage: adb-claw swipe X1 Y1 X2 Y2 [--duration 300]
tools.when_to_use: To scroll content or dismiss UI.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Smart scroll using screen or cached element bounds.
tools.when_to_use: Prefer this over raw swipe for page navigation.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Input ASCII text into the focused field.
tools.when_to_use: After tapping an input field to focus it.

tools.name: key
tools.when_to_use: To navigate back, go home, confirm input, or control device.

tools.name: clear_field
tools.description: Clear the focused input field. Optional cached element tap first.
tools.when_to_use: Before typing into a field that already has text.

tools.name: open
tools.description: Open a URI or app deep link.
tools.when_to_use: To jump to a screen or pass CJK text as a URL parameter.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait for a UI element or activity to appear or disappear.
tools.usage: adb-claw wait {--text TEXT | --id ID | --activity NAME} [--gone] [--timeout ms]
tools.when_to_use: Instead of polling observe after a navigation.

tools.name: monitor
tools.description: Stream or collect UI text via accessibility. Host owns --duration.
tools.when_to_use: Live streams / video pages where uiautomator dump hangs.

tools.name: serve
tools.description: Persistent JSONL session. observe returns state_id; act uses it and never re-dumps.
tools.when_to_use: Flash/Live adapters that need a long-lived low-latency control socket.

tools.name: bench
tools.description: Measure observe/dump/screenshot/tap p50/p95 on a connected device.
tools.when_to_use: To collect a repeatable latency baseline.

tools.name: app_launch
tools.description: Launch an app by package name.

tools.name: app_current
tools.description: Get the currently focused app and activity.
tools.when_to_use: To load an App Profile or confirm navigation.

tools.name: device_info
tools.description: Get device details: model, screen size, Android version.
tools.when_to_use: At the start of a session.

tools.name: ui_tree
tools.description: Dump the indexed UI tree and refresh the action snapshot.
tools.when_to_use: When you need UI structure without a screenshot.

tools.name: live_cart
tools.description: Grab products from a Douyin live shopping cart.
tools.when_to_use: When viewing a Douyin live stream with a shopping cart.

workflow_hints.observe_first: Run observe once, then act from data.ui.elements[].center or --index against that snapshot. Do not re-observe after every tap unless the page changed.
workflow_hints.prefer_center_or_snapshot: tap X Y from center is fastest. tap --index uses the last snapshot and fails with STALE_STATE if it expired. Never tap screenshot-image pixels.
workflow_hints.avoid_refresh: Do not pass --refresh unless observe failed or the snapshot expired.
workflow_hints.type_after_focus: Tap an input field first, then type.
workflow_hints.scroll_pattern: Prefer scroll over swipe. Observe after scrolling.
workflow_hints.serve_for_realtime: For Flash/Live loops use adb-claw serve and act(state_id, handle).
workflow_hints.error_handling: STALE_STATE means re-observe. Do not guess a new index.
